At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Credit Solutions Associate in our Melbourne HQ, you will empower members with knowledge and provides options to bring their past due accounts current in order to preserve and safeguard the credit union from unnecessary loss. Acts as a representative of SCCU, by providing quality service for our members.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options: This position is Hybrid with 2 days per week required in office.
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Credit Solutions Associate Key Responsibilities

  • Provides solutions which will bring past due accounts current, excluding legal and bankrupt accounts, in order to keep delinquent loans to a minimum. Works all loans to include but not limited to consumer, mortgage, and business loans.
  • Accepts all inbound phone calls to the department, makes payment arrangements, transfers payments, and researches past due loan problems. Sends accurate loan error corrections to the Loan Servicing Department.
  • Attempts telephone contact with all past due members (including all co-makers) as presented on the predictive dialer.
  • Provide the member with solutions to delinquency such as a payment plan to bring the loan current, refinance, modification, loan extension, rewrite, short sale, deed- in-lieu or other local programs that may assist them in bringing their loan current during their time of need.
  • Send letters to all member(s) within established department guidelines.
  • Ensures that all work (i.e., phone calls, promises to pay, updates, etc.) is thoroughly documented, using correct action and response codes on the day the action occurs, to maintain accurate records on past due accounts.

Credit Solutions Associate Requirements

  • 1 to 2 years in a consumer debt collections or sales environment.  Experience with Vehicle and Mortgage Collections and Loss Mitigation preferred
  • High School Diploma or equivalency required

Credit Solutions Associate Compensation

  • Starting Salary: $22.18 - $23.48/hour
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule:

  • Monday - Friday 10:00AM  - 7:00PM.  Saturdays on rotation 9:00AM - 3:00PM.

As a PPM System Admin, you will be responsible for the administration, optimization, and support of SCCU’s PPM platform within the Project Management Office. This role ensures system integrity, accurate data management, effective workflow configuration, and consistent delivery of reporting and analytics to support organizational decision‑making. The PPM System Administrator manages system configuration, user access, data governance, and resource management; develops and maintains dashboards and reports; troubleshoots technical and functional issues; and drives process improvements to enhance project and portfolio management capabilities. The role also provides user training and serves as a liaison between the PMO, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure the platform meets evolving organizational needs. This is highly visible position where the users of this platform include Executives, Project/Program Managers, Resource Managers and Team Members.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Flexible Schedule Options
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

PPM System Admin Responsibilities:

  • Administer, configure, and maintain the SCCU’s PPM platform, ensuring reliable day‑to‑day system performance and data accuracy across all portfolios.
  • Troubleshoot, document, and resolve system and configuration issues; escalate complex problems when necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using the PPM platform and Power BI to support leadership decision‑
  • Analyze business needs and translate requirements into technical configurations, workflow automation, integrations, and process improvements within the PPM environment.
  • Design, build, and implement custom configurations within the PPM tool’s development environment, ensuring all enhancements are fully tested, validated, and prepared for deployment to production.
  • Provide user support, training, demonstrations, and clear process documentation to improve system adoption and enhance user proficiency.
  • Support strategic planning by managing the project intake process, tracking business cases, generating preliminary resource-loaded plans, and conducting what-if scenario planning. This results in recommendations regarding the mix and timing of projects to maximize resource utilization and support SCCU’s strategic objectives.
  • Oversee and manage the PMO's SharePoint document library, creating new project subsites, managing approval workflows, and performing quality assurance on documents to ensure project managers adhere to SCCU standards.

PPM System Admin Minimum Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring proven experience administering enterprise level PPM systems such as Planview, Clarity, Microsoft Project Server, ServiceNow PPM, Primavera, or similar system, Planview ProjectAdvantage is highly preferred. A strong understanding of project management, portfolio management, resource planning, and demand management concepts is required. Success in this role requires proficiency in data analysis, workflow configuration, data governance, system integrations, and the ability to produce meaningful insights through reporting tools such as Power BI and PPM system reporting modules. Candidates must demonstrate strong analytical, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills with exceptional attention to detail, as well as the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and perform effectively in both structured and ambiguous environments.

3–5 years of experience administering enterprise Project Portfolio Management (PPM) platforms—such as Planview (preferred), Clarity, Microsoft Project Server, ServiceNow PPM, Primavera, or similar tools—and working within a Project Management Office (PMO), IT governance, enterprise systems administration, or business process management environment.

Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or similar STEM concentration is required. Equivalent work experience.

PPM platform training or certification in Planview, Clarity, ServiceNow PPM, Microsoft Project Server, or Primavera strongly preferred.

Power BI or data analytics training is highly beneficial, including experience with data modeling, reporting, and visualization.
